title: NASA solves a strange mystery hidden inside asteroid Bennu’s boulders
caption:
NASA has finally cracked the case of asteroid Bennu’s temperature mystery. By scanning returned samples, researchers found that internal fractures are the secret to why it cools so rapidly.

Source: Sciencedaily - NASA solves a strange mystery hidden inside asteroid Bennu’s boulders
